sculpt_golem_rock.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_golem_rock.source: tools/sculpt/assets/golem_rock.mjs (node, facet kit on the mon_golem_big skeleton and clips)
sculpt_golem_rock.notes: Crystal golem (combat golem / earth guardian): facet-kit boulders rigid on the mon_golem_big bones (legs, hunched chest, brow-rock head with glowing eye slits, three-stone arms with fist boulders), moss on the tops, a crown of cyan crystals (GolemShards, hidden when the armour breaks). Same joints, inverse binds and clips as mon_golem_big.
